_help.show_dir: Default show profile folder (show.json + episodes/). See docs/show-profile.md; examples/show is a template.
_help.media_root: Folder that holds the raw episode folders. Episode configs store work/raw paths relative to it. Several shows: "shows": {"<show id>": {"media_root": "..."}}.
_help.premiere_mcp: Your clone of the premiere-mcp repo (tq/fill_holes.py runs its server/src/transcribe.py).
_help.gpu_python: Python with torch + torchaudio for tq/align.py and tq/verify_cuts.py. Empty = the Python running the script.
_help.whisper_python: Python with faster-whisper for tq/fill_holes.py. Empty = the Python running the script.
_help.ffmpeg: ffmpeg executable, or just ffmpeg if it is on PATH.
_help.asr_device: Device for NeMo-Speech.cpp in tq/asr_nemotron.py (cuda, or what your build supports). Optional: nemo_speech (binary path), nemotron_model (decoder gguf).
